alt.zh-CN: 头像图片或文字的替代文本。
alt.en-US: Alternative text for the avatar image or text.

border.zh-CN: 额外边框，传 `true` 或 `{ color, motion }`；`motion` 为 `true` 时开启边框动效。
border.en-US: Additional border: `true` or `{ color, motion }`; `motion: true` enables the border animation.

bottomSlot.zh-CN: 底部标记配置，包含 `shape`、`text`、`bgColor`、`textColor`、`class` 和 `style`；`text` 为文字，或返回自定义内容的函数（标记显示时才调用）；传入 `render` 时完全由它渲染。
bottomSlot.en-US: Bottom badge configuration: `shape`, `text`, `bgColor`, `textColor`, `class` and `style`; `text` is text or a function returning custom content, called only when the badge shows; a `render` function replaces the whole badge.

children.zh-CN: 头像内的文字或自定义内容。
children.en-US: Text or custom content inside the avatar.

color.en-US: Preset background color of the avatar.

contentMotion.zh-CN: 启用头像内容区域的动画。
contentMotion.en-US: Enables animation in the avatar content area.

gap.zh-CN: 字符内容与头像左右两侧的间距，单位为像素。
gap.en-US: Space in pixels between the text and either side of the avatar.

hoverMask.zh-CN: 鼠标悬停时显示的覆盖层内容，覆盖层没有默认样式。
hoverMask.en-US: Overlay content shown on hover; the overlay has no default style.

imgAttr.zh-CN: 传给内部 `img` 元素的原生属性。
imgAttr.en-US: Native attributes applied to the inner `img` element.

onError.zh-CN: 图片加载失败时调用，不传事件参数。返回 `false` 时保留损坏的图片，不切换为文字回退。
onError.en-US: Called when the image fails to load, without an event argument. Returning `false` keeps the broken image instead of switching to the text fallback.

size.zh-CN: 头像尺寸，支持预设名称或合法 CSS 尺寸。
size.en-US: Avatar size, as a preset name or a valid CSS size.

srcSet.zh-CN: 图片头像的响应式资源集合。

topSlot.zh-CN: 顶部标记配置，包含 `text`、`gradientStart`、`gradientEnd`、`textColor`、`class` 和 `style`；`text` 为文字，或返回自定义内容的函数（标记显示时才调用）；传入 `render` 时完全由它渲染。
topSlot.en-US: Top badge configuration: `text`, `gradientStart`, `gradientEnd`, `textColor`, `class` and `style`; `text` is text or a function returning custom content, called only when the badge shows; a `render` function replaces the whole badge.

maxCount.zh-CN: 显示的最大头像数，超出后显示 `+N`。
maxCount.en-US: Maximum number of visible avatars; overflow is shown as `+N`.

overlapFrom.zh-CN: 头像重叠方向，可选 `start` 或 `end`。

renderMore.zh-CN: 自定义溢出标签。调用时传入剩余数量和被隐藏头像的渲染函数数组，返回的内容替代默认的 `+N`。被隐藏的头像在调用渲染函数处才创建，传入的属性覆盖头像自身的属性。
renderMore.en-US: Custom overflow label. It receives the remaining count and render functions for the hidden avatars, and its result replaces the default `+N`. A hidden avatar is created where its render function is called; the props passed override the avatar's own.

shape.en-US: Shape of the avatars in the group.

size.en-US: Size of the avatars in the group.
